provenance.template: Green exam title, stretched red school/department, year/code subtitle and author; no date/duration/name fields. 13pt body, leading 0.95em, red question labels; three-platform footer.
source_notes: Five photographed pages in source order; page 1 is lower resolution (618x800) than pages 2-5 (1583x2048). Contents were checked against enlarged crops of every question and diagram.
The source contains only the question paper: 12 multiple-choice, 4 true/false and 6 short-answer questions. No answer key or solutions were supplied, so no solution content was generated.
Printed exam date is 26/10/2026; the source states the paper has 05 pages.
provenance.figures: First two source geometry figures redrawn with correct labels and hidden edges. Variation tables rebuilt without spurious vertical lines; smooth derivative quartic through source marked points; corner apparatus rebuilt to source perspective.
content_notes: I-3 is printed as y = 2x + 1 + 3/(x + 3), not a single rational fraction; the oblique asymptote is requested.
I-5 asks for the vertical asymptote; its table continues from page 1 to page 2.
II-3 retains the printed statement y' > 0, forall x in RR exactly as a true/false assertion.
II-4 keeps the printed force magnitudes and the 120-degree angle between the two in-plane forces.

qa.content: 22 questions in source order; all sections I-III transcribed from pages 1-5; no answers or writing variant
qa.figures: Standalone composite inspected against all five extracted source pages; first two geometry figures, four variation tables, derivative graph and apparatus corrected. Full-page visual review remains pending.
qa.pagination: 5 pages verified. II-4 full-width prompt followed by a–d left / force figure right grid; all four statements on page 4. III-5 figure, III-6 and HẾT together on page 5.
qa.fonts: All fonts embedded (pdffonts). Body 13pt and paragraph leading 0.95em.

Graph labels drawn above curves with white backing. All variation tables 118mm, uniform 0.42 stroke and #F2B8C5 header; forces/apparatus strokes 0.55.
qa.latest_figures: Force diagram redrawn in a wider compact projection at 82mm with alpha inside the lower-right corner and readable labels. I-7 enlarged to 68mm, minimum positioned at x=0 and negative-one labels offset from curve.
qa.spacing: Body 13pt, leading 0.90em; question gap increased from 3mm to 4mm. II-1 statement gap 4.5mm, other statement gaps unchanged. Rebuilt and verified 5 pages with HẾT after III-6 on page 5.
qa.latest_revision: II-1 statement gap increased to 4.5mm. All four variation tables use one filled outer rectangular ring of uniform 0.5-unit thickness and 0.5-unit separators. Rebuilt; five pages retained, II-1 a–d on page 3 and HẾT on final page.
qa.choice_layout: I-7 and I-8 choices changed to two columns/two rows; I-7 retains right-hand figure. Rebuilt and checked extracted layout; five pages retained.
